description: This file defines models and a fetcher class for retrieving and processing ETF equity exposure data from the Financial Modeling Prep API, including query parameter classes, data normalization, and asynchronous data fetching.

classes.name: FMPEtfEquityExposureQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for ETF equity exposure requests, allowing multiple symbols.

classes.name: FMPEtfEquityExposureData
classes.description: Represents the ETF equity exposure data with field normalization for percentage values.

classes.name: FMPEtfEquityExposureFetcher
classes.description: Handles fetching, transforming, and processing ETF equity exposure data asynchronously from the API.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of parameters into a query parameter object.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches data for given symbols from the API, handling multiple requests concurrently.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw API data into validated data model instances, sorted by market value.

methods.name: normalize_percent
methods.description: Normalizes percentage values by dividing by 100.
